title: The Pocket Metropolis | ECHO//100 Episode 51
description: Kavi struggles to maintain his portable city while Mira attempts to interface with its corrupted, sentient data core. Byte's interference causes the reality to fracture as a familiar shadow emerges from within the miniature skyline. Episode 51 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original fiction production.

scenes.text: The file slips, blooming into a pulsing, miniature metropolis hovering above Kavi’s trembling palms.
scenes.caption: City in the palm
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses holding a glowing, miniature city above his palm in the White Expanse.

scenes.text: Mira manifests beside Kavi, her teal coat shimmering as she reaches into dense data.
scenes.caption: Mira interfaces with code
scenes.image_prompt: Mira, wearing a blue holographic teal coat, reaching her hand into the glowing miniature city Kavi holds.

scenes.text: The buildings shift like living nerves, reacting instantly to the spike of Kavi’s fear.
scenes.caption: Sentient architecture reacts
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of miniature skyscrapers morphing and shifting shape in response to Kavi's nervous expression.

scenes.text: Byte drifts closer, his orange antenna sparking with static while attempting to stabilize the core.
scenes.caption: Byte approaches the city
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a floating white entity with a cyan face and orange antenna, hovering near the miniature city.

scenes.text: Contact! Byte’s touch turns the vibrant skyscrapers into hollow, flickering wireframe silhouettes of ghost towers.
scenes.caption: Buildings turn to wireframe
scenes.image_prompt: The miniature city buildings becoming translucent wireframe outlines as Byte's hand touches the center.

scenes.text: Byte’s presence fails to fix the city, instead deleting the foundation of the portable reality.
scenes.caption: Byte causes corruption
scenes.image_prompt: Byte looking shocked as the city he touches begins to dissolve into binary code fragments.

scenes.text: The sky above the tiny district rips open, revealing a dark, distorted void beneath streets.
scenes.caption: The sky tears open
scenes.image_prompt: A jagged tear in the digital sky of the miniature city showing deep black-purple void space.

scenes.text: Null emerges, a gargantuan shadow looming over skyscrapers, his red eyes burning through the world.
scenes.caption: Null looms over city
scenes.image_prompt: A massive, shadowy figure with red eyes, Null, towering over the tiny city held in Kavi's hands.
